_comment: Five-day rotating market cycle of Kengtung Township. anchorDate is a date on which slot 0 was held; every slot repeats every 5 days. Only slot 0 is confirmed — Mekong News reported 2026-03-10 (Tabaung waning 8, Tuesday) as Kat Taung market day. The other four slots are placeholders for the field survey: fill in id/name/lat/lng/confidence and nothing else needs to change.

description.en: One of the five markets of the Kengtung cycle. The old market ground here is also where the once-a-year Sawbwa Market Day is held.
